thread:
Nia: quick heads up  v2->v1 silent switching observed on /embeddings for tenant-19. No console indication and CS flagged an unexpected semantic regression.
Owen: That's bad. Do we have a timeframe?
Nia: 08:22-08:28 UTC, ~120 requests. Logs show model hash mismatch in 90% of them. `fallback_reason=quantize_fail` in some.
telemetry-bot: metric spike: header_version_mismatch_total{tenant=\"tenant-19\", route=\"/embeddings\"} +98 in 6m.
Harpreet: Quantize failures should not cause a routing downgrade unless we've exhausted v2 variants. We need clearer decisioning.
Nia: Suggestion: change fallback classification so console shows a \"compat-risk\" flag when semantic-sensitive endpoints (embeddings, rerank) fallback.
Owen: Agree. For embeddings an unexpected fallback is higher severity than for chat. Add a weighting factor per route.
Harpreet: Telemetry side: add `route_severity_weight` and compute `weighted_divergence = sum(route_severity_weight * version_divergence_rate) by (tenant)`. Then alert on weighted metric.
Nia: UX tweak: in drilldown table show `semantic_risk` column + quick example: original vs downgraded embedding cos similarity sample.
Owen: Good. Also add a regression-checker: when fallback happens for embeddings >50 reqs, run an automated eval on a small seed set to estimate similarity drop and notify CS.
telemetry-bot: action queued: run-eval(seed=embeddings_critical_10) for tenant-19.
Harpreet: We'll need a privacy guardrail before running evals on tenant data. Use anonymized samples + customer opt-out.
Nia: Right. We'll only run auto-evals on synthetic prompt seeds or customer-approved testsets. Add an opt-out flag on org settings.
Owen: For billing, we should tag routed tokens as \"routed_version=\" so invoices reflect reality. If route downgraded, billing line shows v1 unit costs.
Nia: Good call. Also write a short CS playbook: how to explain sudden embedding deltas (capacity/quantization/compat).
Harpreet: Implementation steps: 1) add route severity weights config 2) compute weighted_divergence at scrape 3) add embeddings-specific probe alert 4) wire auto-eval job (opt-in) 5) surface `semantic_risk` in drilldown.
Owen: I'll own the auto-eval orchestration. Harpreet owns metrics, Nia owns the CS playbook.
telemetry-bot: metric `weighted_divergence` added to catalog (pending).
Nia: Thanks, we should also add a follow-up to document fallback policies so customers understand when we will silently downgrade.
